author: nocapsnonumbers
body: There is a bug so after invincibility ends, the compass stops working which makes it really hard to play the game and hunt for players.

title: Elimination Compass

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Yeah - compasses, kit selectors and shops have been acting pretty weird for me recently too.

I played a game of walls and spawned with 6 or 7 compasses (only one of which actually worked). Also, lately when I've been playing Nexus the Kit Selector and Pointstreak Shop haven't been appearing in my inventory.
